# Reliability and Recovery Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that failure handling, retries, rollback, compensation, safe-stop and resumption are fully and measurably specified.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is failure classification (transient or permanent) specified per stage, with unclassified failures leading to safe-stop? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-014, §FR-ORC-018; PD-003; ADR-013] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Are fallback paths enumerated per stage, with a requirement that their use is visible at release readiness? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-016; workflow-graph.v2.yaml ST-10a, ST-10b] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is compensation specified for every committed external effect (staging promotion), including non-rollbackable data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-042] [D18] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all safe-stop triggers enumerated, including scheduler stall and interruption detected at startup? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-018; Plan §6.1 (CR-002)] [D19] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is resume behavior specified: who may resume, the preconditions, and which nodes re-run or do not? [Completeness, Spec §FR-ORC-019, §A-016; PD-011] [D20] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Is idempotency required for repeatable operations, including promotion? [Completeness, CON VIII; ADR-012] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Are retry bounds quantified (attempts, backoff base, factor, cap)? [Measurability, PVT-004; workflow-graph.v2.yaml defaults] [D16] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it stated that permanent failures are never retried? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-014] [D16] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Are per-stage timeouts quantified, together with how a timeout is classified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-ORC-015; PVT-005] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Are rollback and compensation defined distinctly, each with the state it restores and the evidence it must produce? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-017; ADR-012] [D17] [D18] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Is a rollback claim made verifiable by defining "last known-good" and how it is checked? [Measurability, Spec §SCN-B-AC4, §FR-ORC-035] [D17] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "consistent" in "safe-stop leaves state consistent" defined (no node RUNNING, workspace retained, gate state preserved)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-ORC-018; Plan §6.1] [D19] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Is interruption-test coverage quantified (one per stage boundary) with its pass criterion (same terminal outcome, no duplicate side effects)? [Measurability, PVT-006] [D20] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Is the outcome specified when compensation itself fails? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases; ADR-012] [D18] [D19] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK015 Is persistence unavailability specified for both creation and redirect? [Coverage, Spec §FR-SHR-015] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Is analytics failure during redirect specified, including the loss accounting ruled at Human Gate 4? [Coverage, Spec §FR-SHR-011; ADR-019] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK017 Is partial failure in parallel branches specified (siblings continue to the sync point, which holds)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-ORC-039] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Are dependency-unavailability scenarios (advisory source, staging process) specified with outcomes? [Coverage, Plan §6.1] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
